summary.text: Zach Raknerud is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously ran for the same House seat in 2018 and for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Zach Raknerud was born in Fargo, North Dakota, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Dakota in 2016.
His career experience includes working in executive management in the retail sector.
Raknerud was a Democratic candidate for North Dakota House District 5 in 2018, when Scott Louser and Jay Fisher won the two seats.
In 2020 he was the Democratic candidate for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat, which incumbent Kelly Armstrong won.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 5 on June 9, 2026.
